newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi's ADNOC lifts October crude prices.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi's ADNOC lifts October crude prices.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) has increased the price of its crudes lifted in October between $1.40 and $1.55 a barrel, the company said on Monday.
Murban and Lower Zakum are increased by $1.50 a barrel to $23.80 and $23.85 a barrel respectively.
Umm Shaif is $1.55 higher at $23.55 and Upper Zakum is $1.40 higher at $21.95.
The higher official selling prices reflect strong crude markets and premiums for ADNOC grades last month.
